data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Badal is the god of rain and clouds. He is also known as Indra, the king of gods. Badal's symbol is the thunderbolt, which he uses to bring rain and prosperity to the earth. The name Badal carries the meaning “God of Rain, Cloud” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
